title: Faculty Info Lecturer on Education Degrees J.D., Harvard Law School, (2015)
bio: Sam Straus is an educator, facilitator, and former lawyer. He teaches the Negotiation Workshop and Fugitive Negotiation: Negotiating Power, Space and Purpose with/in Educational Institutions.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
